notes: Pinned by a person after review.

USDA and Open Food Facts disagree (protein: 19 vs 59; calories: 140 vs 440; carbs: 5 vs 16; fiber: 1 vs 3; sugar: 1 vs 3; fat: 5 vs 14); a reviewer accepted the USDA label data: Open Food Facts disagrees on every field, but all six are off by the same ~3.0-3.2x factor (e.g. calories 140 vs 440, protein 19 vs 59) consistent with OFF holding per-100g values against this product's ~32g serving rather than a real conflict. The USDA label data (per official manufacturer submission) already matches our existing catalogue values closely.
Follow-up to this batch's first pass: pinning again with acceptUsdaReason now that the OFF disagreement is understood to be a unit-scaling artifact, not a real data conflict.
